items.title: 2026-018: Critical Vulnerabilities in PHP
items.summary: CERT-EU advisory on two critical PHP flaws allowing unauthenticated remote code execution, fixed in 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35. PoCs are circulating, raising exploitation likelihood.

items.title: 2026-019: Critical Vulnerability in GitLab Community and Enterprise Editions
items.summary: GitLab patched a critical flaw enabling unauthenticated arbitrary code execution on GitLab servers. CERT-EU urges prioritising internet-facing instances and compromise assessment.

items.title: 2026-017: Critical Vulnerability in Cisco Secure Email Gateway
items.summary: Cisco Secure Email Gateway AMP feature contains a critical flaw allowing unauthenticated remote attackers to write files and run commands as root. Cisco PSIRT reports active exploitation; patch immediately.

items.title: CISA Flags SonicWall SonicOS MFA Bypass Flaw Amid Reports of Possible Exploitation
items.summary: CISA added SonicWall SonicOS flaw CVE-2026-19868 (MFA/authentication bypass, CVSS 7.1/7.5) to its KEV catalog after reports of possible in-the-wild exploitation. Edge devices should be patched urgently.

items.title: EXCLUSIVE: Covert Russian network exploited French riots on social media, EU report says
items.summary: Reuters reports an EU assessment describing a covert Russian network amplifying and exploiting French riots on social media, continuing hybrid influence operations against EU member states.

items.title: An average of 8 minutes is all hackers need to log in with stolen credentials
items.summary: Elastic Security Threat Command found attackers logged in with stolen credentials an average of eight minutes after infostealer infection across 27 cases, also abusing AI apps and signed RMM tools for persistence.

items.title: Disposable: The ordinary people doing Russia’s dirty work
items.summary: Politico investigation into the Kremlin recruiting ordinary civilians as disposable proxies to carry out sabotage operations across Europe, a direct physical threat to critical infrastructure operators.

items.title: G7 ministers to discuss recent cyber attacks, Italy says
items.summary: Italy says G7 ministers will discuss recent cyberattacks, signalling coordinated political attention to a current wave of incidents.

items.title: Scans for Sshole Vulnerability (CVE-2026-123158), (Sun, Nov 8th)
items.summary: SANS ISC honeypots observe rising exploitation attempts against the 'sshole' SSH vulnerability (CVE-2026-123158), delivered via unusually long SSH password fields.

items.title: EU countries still can’t get it together on AI
items.summary: Politico reports 16 EU member states have not yet appointed AI safety authorities and many missed a key data centre reporting deadline, slowing AI Act implementation.

items.title: Investment scams with potential victims in at least 50 countries: over 100 servers seized
items.summary: German-led Europol-supported operation seized over 100 servers and searched 17 locations targeting a supplier of fraudulent trading websites used by investment scam call centres; losses estimated above EUR 4 million, seven suspects identified.

items.title: Wirken: Open-source AI agent gateway
items.summary: Wirken is an open-source gateway between messaging apps and AI agents, designed on the assumption agents can be hijacked via prompt injection and limiting what a compromised agent can reach.

items.title: Iran says no unauthorised vessels transited Strait of Hormuz overnight after navigation aids destroyed
items.summary: Iran states no unauthorised vessels transited the Strait of Hormuz overnight after navigation aids were destroyed, signalling continued escalation risk in the region.

items.title: Rubio says war on Iran unpopular but ‘necessary’ to stop nuclear threat
items.summary: US Secretary of State Rubio called war with Iran unpopular but 'necessary' to halt its nuclear programme, dismissing Tehran's negotiation demands.

items.title: Huawei says it’s made a 100 percent Chinese PC
items.summary: Register roundup: Huawei claims a fully domestically produced Chinese PC, Japan declares an information security emergency, plus other regional tech news.

items.title: Wirecard fugitive claimed he toppled Sebastian Kurz in messages to Russian spy
items.summary: Politico reports that Wirecard fugitive Jan Marsalek claimed, in messages to a convicted Russian spy, involvement in an operation that toppled Austrian chancellor Sebastian Kurz in 2021.

items.title: Iris Ohyama data cloud breach exposes info of 7.7 million customers
items.summary: Japanese manufacturer Iris Ohyama disclosed that personal data of around 7.7 million people may have been exposed via unauthorised access to a third-party cloud service.

items.title: Week in review: Refrigeration cyberattacks hit European retailers again, Patch Tuesday forecast
items.summary: Help Net Security weekly roundup covering renewed refrigeration-system cyberattacks on European retailers, Google's disruption of the XCPE botnet and the Patch Tuesday forecast.

items.title: Staff at the US center for AI safety are reporting to the White House, raising independence concerns
items.summary: AP reports staff at the US AI safety center now report to the White House, raising concerns about the body's independence in evaluating AI risks.

items.title: Not a game: Europol and partners target terrorist role-playing online
items.summary: Europol's EU IRU and Spain coordinated a referral action day with 16 countries against violent extremist and terrorist role-playing content in online gaming environments.

items.title: Jensen Huang: Silicon Valley superstar engulfed by personal scandal
items.summary: BBC profile of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, now facing scandal over an affair with a woman suspected of spying for China.

items.title: Companies seeking an MSP doubt their ability to spot cyberattacks
items.summary: Barracuda survey finds 66% of organisations already outsource security to an MSP and many doubt their own ability to detect attacks, prioritising recovery and AI risk management from providers.

items.title: Le Pen’s plan to end EU diplomacy
items.summary: Politico analysis of Marine Le Pen's plans affecting EU foreign policy, as US-Ukraine-Russia trilateral talks take place in Abu Dhabi.

items.title: Linus Torvalds sees signs AI-prompted patch flood has peaked
items.summary: Linus Torvalds reports signs that the flood of AI-generated Linux kernel patches has peaked, with fixes arriving faster than new bug reports.

items.title: Trump defends Nvidia CEO amid Chinese spying allegations
items.summary: Trump publicly defended Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang after Huang admitted an affair with a woman suspected of spying for China.

items.title: Marine Le Pen is coming after Kaja Kallas
items.summary: Politico reports political pressure on EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas from Marine Le Pen amid tensions with von der Leyen.

items.title: The Kremlin call: How talking to Putin exposed Europe’s deepest rift over Ukraine
items.summary: Analysis of European divisions after Finnish and Norwegian leaders contacted Putin directly, highlighting the continent's limited leverage in US-brokered Ukraine peace talks.

items.title: Putin may not want peace, warns Norwegian leader who spoke to him
items.summary: Norwegian PM Støre tells Politico he does not expect a breakthrough at the Abu Dhabi talks and warns Putin may not want peace.

items.title: China extends suspensions of 24% tariff on US goods, port fees on US ships for two months
items.summary: China extended suspension of 24% tariffs on US goods and port fees on US ships for two months.

items.title: Nvidia's out-of-hour shares fall as firm probes CEO Jensen Huang
items.summary: Nvidia shares fell in after-hours trading as the company investigates CEO Jensen Huang over allegations linked to a suspected Chinese spy.

items.title: ISC Stormcast For Monday, November 9th, 2026 https://isc.sans.edu/podcastdetail/10170, (Mon, Nov 9th)
items.summary: Daily SANS Internet Storm Center podcast episode covering current threat and vulnerability news.

items.title: Trump to meet Qatar's prime minister as Iran diplomacy faces hurdles
items.summary: Trump is set to meet Qatar's prime minister as diplomacy with Iran stalls.

items.title: Poland mourns victims of Krakow shooting amid security fears
items.summary: Poland is mourning victims of a shooting in Krakow amid heightened public security concerns.

items.title: Europe will be represented in Abu Dhabi talks on Ukraine, French foreign minister says
items.summary: French foreign minister says Europeans will be represented at the US-brokered Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi, without naming participants.

items.title: Europeans will join Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi, French minister says
items.summary: Reuters reports Europeans will join the Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi according to the French minister; duplicates earlier coverage.

items.title: World Models Will Soon Be Inescapable. Here’s What You Need to Know
items.summary: Wired explainer on world models that simulate real-world physics to train robots and autonomous vehicles, moving AI beyond text.
